svg.title: step-flow: a side pane that lists the steps Claude finished
svg.desc: Animated demo in four steps. Run /flow to open the pane. Finished steps appear in it, and a blocked step shows its cause and the work that was not done. Click a step to see what Claude tried and which commands it ran. Ask a question in the pane without changing your current conversation.
